selection.rule: Same metadata-only selection, exclude all N1/N2/N6/N7/N8/N9 and historical/R40H/R37/R40CDE targets, days, sky and raw source hashes including N5A bank/replay; four fresh Parkes groups, minimum two, otherwise HOLD. Freeze manifest before any new power; freeze model before fresh reads.

same_receiver.rule: Re-query exact base and _S/_R aliases from full old 237-candidate ledger and current archive index. Deterministic priority: previously candidate cadence then all other names. Detailed gate labels replacing unlabeled assertions; original strict 16 rows, expected source, frequency, time, WCS and pointing gates unchanged; exact N6 native resolution/time match. No power until both manifests frozen.

uwl.rule: Separately report Parkes UWL subband transfer (receiver, native cadence/frequency differences; no pooled same-receiver conclusion). Query metadata-only 22 published TIC systems excluding corrupt TIC 251852984, additional TIC aliases from index, explicit _S/_R, published dates not selection by event results. Four native windows 2850/3050/3250/3330 MHz; high-resolution HDF5, matching headers, same physical scan per four subbands, exactly four alternating ON/OFF independent scans in same cadence, actual source and pointing and signed WCS checked. At least 16 native integrations, first 16 consecutive original rows with no resampling, record original nrows/df/ts; only Stokes/total-intensity one IF, no polarization mixing. Header-based timing, metadata MJD rounding <=5 sec; same sky exclusion and same-day disjointness across lanes. Fail closed if missing subband or incompatible metadata. Predeclare fixed one-file-per-window selection, no power-based replacement. Use old N10 model, no fit or cutoff changes, score same bin/time template as a transfer test.

gbt_s.rule: GBT separate S-band transfer windows 1900,2100,2300,2500 MHz (not same frequency domain); max 80 metadata-selected previously unseen targets; on/off explicit roles and strict native 16 rows, matched signed grid, time, independently corroborated pointing; GBT distinct OFF positions permitted by original R37B GBT rule, not treated as same-receiver replication. No artificial ON/OFF. Alternate archive references ATA and COSMIC documented only pending comparable public raw spectra.

published_uwl.note: Published study describes 25 sessions, 3650 HDF5 files, but availability/qualification of particular files is unverified; use only public source metadata, not published signal labels.

independence: All pinned historical manifests, N1/N2/N6/N7/N8/N9 and N10 864 excluded native hashes, target aliases, days, files, sky guard 0.1 deg. Metadata-only freeze before power. No use of previously assessed 3I/ATLAS data; explicitly exclude ATLAS variants. Separate lane gates require >=2 qualified and acquired groups; no pooled results; count failed acquisitions as HOLD for entire lane, do not replace after exposure. GBT S-band is a standalone transfer domain; no pooled metrics. Explicitly retain N10B no replacement after power. Diagnostic headers only do not constitute training.
model: Exact authenticated N10 lock reused byte-for-byte, no training, no threshold selection, parent N7/N8/N9 frozen and unchanged. Test all 24 N10 variants descriptively; no external exam. Use N10 measure and exact Turbo parity. Same synthetic injection and stationary repeat stress, native recorded backgrounds. Gate zero paired ordinary/shared/weak/stress losses, at least one stress case, controls <=35/640 and <=7/8 Learned05. Retain per-group artifacts, source hashes, metadata rejection ledger. Production R28 unchanged. No fit entrypoint in N10C. Pass old lock unchanged through N10 group and measure. Report per-lane gates. If fewer than two suitable groups per lane, HOLD.

audit.parkes: Reproduce exactly the 80 unlabeled rejection records from authenticated N10B manifest: requery target, preserve cadence order and day, report old versus current cadence count and ordinal; extract traceback last frame, exception type, source line and bounded header/metadata fields, no exception suppression; if cannot match mark unresolved. All 123 old cadence candidates may be requalified without power, same strict gates; no changes to scientific criteria.
audit.positive_control: Known previously acquired N10 development group checks exact header and same-receiver qualifier with empty historical sky list; prior ATLAS public directory listing from official BL release (metadata only), bounded crawl and HDF5 headers. ATLAS and old known data are controls, permanently excluded from fresh tests.
audit.uwl: Audit exact raw response keys, actual source names, filename patterns, count at each old filter. Query published TIC IDs plus spaced aliases, fixed TOI aliases explicitly cited in paper; use headers to verify band and source rather than rely on center_freq or fine filename. Only exact target role corroborated by index and header; no guessed cross-ID. Group by actual native tstart, simultaneous subbands, and retain original N10B qualification gates. Header-only scans limited to 160 per target, at most 22 published targets and 16 fixed TOI aliases; no power before freeze.
audit.archive: GBT separate S-band transfer windows 1900,2100,2300,2500 MHz (not same frequency domain); max 80 metadata-selected previously unseen targets; on/off explicit roles and strict native 16 rows, matched signed grid, time, independently corroborated pointing; GBT distinct OFF positions permitted by original R37B GBT rule, not treated as same-receiver replication. No artificial ON/OFF. Alternate archive references ATA and COSMIC documented only pending comparable public raw spectra.
